# Oneiros — instructions for AI assistants

Before doing anything else, read `RESUME-HERE/README.md` and the files it lists, in order.
They hold the owner's rules (RULES.md), the current state (CHECKPOINTS.md), the plan
(ROADMAP.md) and past mistakes (LESSONS-LEARNED.md).

The rules there apply to every session. Most important: **ask clarifying questions before
building (R1)**, and **update RESUME-HERE before you finish (R2)**.
